name: KYC Verification
description: Know Your Customer verification process governed by KYC Verification SOP (KYC-SOP-001) as a compliance obligation.

name: AML Screening
description: Anti-Money Laundering screening process governed by AML Policy (AML-POL-002) as a compliance obligation.

name: Complaint Handling
description: Complaint handling process governed by Complaint Handling Policy (COM-POL-006).

name: Fraud Detection
description: Fraud detection and response process governed by Fraud Policy (FRAUD-POL-007).

name: Director of Product Management
description: Senior leadership role responsible for product strategy and management. Holds sign-off authority on product and risk decisions as evidenced by approval on 2026-01-15.

name: Chief Risk Officer
description: C-suite executive responsible for enterprise risk management and governance. Holds sign-off authority on risk-related decisions as evidenced by approval on 2026-01-15.

name: Compliance Head
description: Senior leadership role responsible for compliance and regulatory obligations. Holds sign-off authority on compliance matters as evidenced by approval on 2026-01-15.
